CM CruiseMesh

Friend-card help

It did not open

Copy the complete link, open CruiseMesh, choose Add a friend, tap Paste, and preview the identity before adding it.

The card looks incomplete

Ask your friend to share it again. The full link must include the text beginning with CMFRIEND1 after the # symbol.

Confirm the person

Compare the four fingerprint words on both phones. Matching words verify that you added the intended cryptographic identity.
